purpose: Append-only point-in-time reconciliation of direct spot snapshots and contemporaneous secondary ETF, derivatives, exchange-reserve and macro context. Research only; not a trading signal or admitted model feature.
raw_response_hash_scope: SHA-256 covers the exact UTF-8 JSON response text rendered by the web retrieval result. Original HTTP wire bytes, headers, transport certificate chain and independent timestamp anchoring were not retained.

limitations: No provider event timestamp; retrieval time is not event time.
Level-1 quote only; no multi-level order-book ladder was captured.
The endpoint's open field is the UTC daily open, not a rolling 24-hour open.
Provider timestamp is 507.028 seconds old at capture and exceeds the 300-second live-feature threshold.
USDT is not normalized to USD.
Level-1 quote only; no multi-level order-book ladder was captured.

secondary_sources.normalized_excerpt:
As of November 5, 2026, XRP (XRP) spot ETFs had recorded no net flows for three consecutive trading days.
Cumulative net inflows: $1.81 billion | Trading volume: $22.30 million | Net assets: $1.41 billion, equivalent to 1.85% of market capitalization.
limitations: Secondary report citing SoSoValue; direct SoSoValue fund-level response and issuer-native files were not captured in this run.
Zero net flow is not a net outflow.
Fund universe, same-close completeness and creation/redemption cash are not independently reconciled.

secondary_sources.source_data_as_of: 2026-11-05 for derivatives metrics; November 6 for spot and macro commentary
secondary_sources.normalized_excerpt: At OKX, open interest across all XRP contracts stood at $106.6 million on October 24, rose to $132.1 million by November 4, and was $122.4 million on November 5. The November 5 long/short account ratio was 3.81. Funding was 0.01% per settlement during November 3–5 and 0.0024% at the early Friday settlement.

reported.long_short_ratio_unit: accounts, not position notional or capital

limitations: The article compiles OKX data but does not retain raw contract-level API responses in this artifact.
Open interest is not directional by itself; every contract has both a long and a short.
The long/short ratio counts accounts, not capital-weighted exposure.
The funding observation is historical and not a current funding quote.
The article's support levels are technical commentary, not verified resting liquidity.

derived_from: CryptoQuant reserve/flow data as described by the article
secondary_sources.normalized_excerpt: Binance XRP reserves reportedly rose from 2.35 billion to 2.63 billion between November 3 and November 5, an increase of about 280 million XRP or 11.9%. The report says deposit transactions increased as a share of Binance XRP activity, but Binance did not identify the source of the additional reserves.
limitations: Secondary report; no raw CryptoQuant series, address universe, reserve wallet list or Binance PoR row was captured in this run.
Transaction share is not XRP volume or net token flow.
The article explicitly leaves open-market purchases, OTC deals and internal Binance wallet transfers as alternatives.
Not directly comparable to CryptoQuant's separately reported 418.5M XRP November 4 exchange-outflow estimate in the related artifact.

secondary_sources.normalized_excerpt: The Nasdaq Composite was reported down 5.52% on Thursday, the S&P 500 down 4.36%, the Dow Jones down 1,833 points or 3.44%, and the Philadelphia semiconductor index down more than 12%.
limitations: Secondary report citing Fox Business; primary index closes were not recaptured in this run.
The equity close is not synchronized to the Kraken/OKX ticker capture.
Macro co-movement does not establish a causal XRP beta for this event window.

derived_checks.interpretation: Arithmetic only. Kraken and OKX quotes use USD and USDT respectively; provider timestamps are not synchronized, USD/USDT conversion and execution costs are absent, and only Level-1 quotes were captured. The raw last-price difference is not an arbitrage observation.

cross_source_reconciliation.interpretation: Two Kraken retrieval-vintage snapshots. Neither has a provider event timestamp; the difference is not a validated event-time return.

reported_support_context.limitation: The $1.19–$1.20 zone and $1.272 moving average are secondary technical references, not order-book liquidity or fundamental valuation.

binance_flow_context.reason: Different metrics, source methods, address universes and time windows. The reserve increase may include internal wallet migration or label changes; the exchange-outflow estimate may include withdrawals or internal movements. No net customer supply change is established.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Broad cross-asset risk-off pressure contributed to XRP weakness.
supporting_evidence: Secondary reporting describes a sharp Nasdaq, S&P 500, Dow and semiconductor-index decline on November 5.
XRP was below its reported 24-hour open and VWAP in the direct exchange snapshots.
disconfirming_or_missing: No synchronized BTC, equity-index futures, dollar, Treasury-yield and XRP event-time panel was captured.
The Kraken endpoint supplies no provider timestamp and the OKX quote is stale under the 300-second rule.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Elevated OKX open interest and a long-heavy account ratio could increase liquidation sensitivity if spot weakness persists.
supporting_evidence: Secondary OKX-derived open interest remained 14.82% above October 24 on November 5 despite the price decline.
The reported November 5 long/short account ratio was 3.81.
disconfirming_or_missing: The account ratio is not capital-weighted.
Open interest fell 7.34% from November 4 to November 5.
Funding declined from 0.01% to 0.0024% per eight-hour settlement, consistent with some cooling.
Raw contract-level OI, liquidation and funding responses were not captured.

competing_hypotheses.claim: A three-session zero-net-flow period removed a source of incremental ETF buying but does not prove ETF redemptions.
supporting_evidence: TokenPost reports zero net flows for November 3–5 and cites SoSoValue.
disconfirming_or_missing: Cumulative net inflows remain reported at $1.81B and net assets at $1.41B.
No issuer-native creation/redemption files or complete fund-level same-close reconciliation were captured.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The reported 280M XRP increase in Binance reserves may reflect customer deposits, OTC transfers, open-market purchases, internal wallet movement or address-label changes.
supporting_evidence: The Crypto Basic article reports reserves increasing from 2.35B to 2.63B XRP between November 3 and 5.
disconfirming_or_missing: No raw reserve wallet set or transaction-level transfer list was captured.
The article explicitly states Binance did not identify the source.
Transaction-share percentages do not establish token-volume net inflow.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The direct spot retrievals are below the $1.19–$1.20 technical zone cited in November 6 secondary analysis.
supporting_evidence: Kraken last is $1.15461 and OKX last is 1.1559 USDT at their respective retrieval vintages.
disconfirming_or_missing: The zone is a secondary chart reference, not a verified order-book depth level.
No synchronized multi-level depth or liquidation map was captured.
The two quote currencies and event times are not normalized.

reasons: OKX provider timestamp age is 507.028 seconds, above the 300-second live-feature threshold.
No synchronized multi-level order-book depth or trade tape.
USD and USDT are not normalized.
Derivatives and ETF metrics are secondary, historical or incomplete.
Binance reserve and outflow observations lack raw address-level provenance and are not comparable.
No point-in-time historical feature window or out-of-sample evaluation was constructed from this capture.

forecast.reason: The snapshot is asynchronous and incomplete. No calibrated out-of-sample model evidence supports a directional forecast.
